end.summary:
Counted sides of kites, triangles, squares, and rectangles.
Counted corners of squares, triangles, rectangles, and circles.
Named shapes from their sides and corners in different positions.
Recognised that triangles have three sides and three corners, regardless of appearance.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners by checking each edge and point, then naming shapes from those counts. Ayaan correctly identified squares, triangles, rectangles, and circles, including triangles that were long or thin. No mix-up was recorded in this lesson. At home, ask them to find 2D shapes around the room and count the sides and corners aloud.
